title: Add schema-declared request parameter file bindings
objective: Define and implement reusable x-llm-req-parameter.file bindings so any dynamic request can turn declared path or content parameter fields into LlmRequest.files through the shared completeRequest boundary, with summarize as the first generic example. Contract sections: requests/README.md#x-llm-req-parameter-metadata; requests/README.md#processing-order; requests/README.md#additional-input-files; requests/README.md#schema-declared-files-and-librarycli-boundaries; requests/README.md#prompt-schema-and-summarize-compatibility; requests/README.md#request-name-and-filesystem-safety.

branch.name: llm-request-lookup
branch.rationale: The work item captures the next bounded request-lookup feature on the existing context branch.

request.text: Prepare a new .docs/work-items/* to define and implement reusable schema-declared file bindings for dynamic request parameters. Update requests/README.md to document x-llm-req-parameter.file with path/content modes, materialization, ordering, cleanup, safety, and shared completeRequest/llm req behavior. Make summarize use path/content parameter fields without a request-name special case. Create a complete governed work item with strategy, implementation, validation, and review tasks. Commit the new work item.

scope.name: schema-contract
scope.description: Define x-llm-req-parameter.file metadata for scalar string path and content bindings, with bounded validation and no executable metadata.
scope.reason: File semantics must be explicitly declared by each request schema.

scope.name: shared-materialization
scope.description: Materialize declared parameter files through one reusable boundary used by completeRequest and llm req.
scope.reason: Request-name special cases and duplicated CLI/library behavior are unacceptable.

scope.name: parameter-api
scope.description: Allow the CLI to pass raw parameter JSON and assignments through the shared boundary so parameters are constructed once.
scope.reason: The shared request layer must own parameter resolution and file interpretation.

scope.name: summarize-example
scope.description: Make requests/summarize declare path/content bindings and work through --p-path/--p-content without a summarize conditional.
scope.reason: Summarize is the concrete generic request example.

scope.name: compatibility-and-evidence
scope.description: Preserve explicit additional files and existing prompt/provider boundaries while adding provider-free tests and package validation.
scope.reason: The feature must be additive and independently verifiable.

scope.name: authoritative-contract
scope.description: Apply only the listed requests/README.md sections; explicit human operator confirmation is required before contract edits.
scope.reason: The request README is authoritative for this implementation batch.

nonGoals.name: executable-assets
nonGoals.description: Do not execute JavaScript, custom validation functions, shell text, templates, or module paths from request assets.
nonGoals.reason: Request metadata remains declarative and bounded.

nonGoals.name: request-name-special-casing
nonGoals.description: Do not infer file behavior from request names or hard-code summarize-specific branches.
nonGoals.reason: The feature must work for arbitrary request bundles through schema metadata.

nonGoals.name: provider-and-release
nonGoals.description: Do not make authenticated provider calls, publish, deploy, or claim production readiness.

nonGoals.name: unrelated-refactor
nonGoals.description: Do not redesign the prompt XML schema, provider projection, output envelope, credentials, or unrelated commands.
nonGoals.reason: Keep the change bounded to declared parameter file bindings.

items.name: file-binding-contract
items.description: Parameter schemas can declare x-llm-req-parameter.file bindings for scalar string path and content values with validated mode, MIME, purpose, name, encoding, and unsupported-metadata behavior.
items.reason: File semantics must be explicit and schema-owned.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Path and content metadata shapes are documented and validated before provider use.
Malformed metadata, unsupported schema-node shapes, and executable validation metadata fail boundedly.

items.name: shared-materialization
items.description: completeRequest materializes schema-declared path/content parameters into ReferenceFile descriptors using shared source safety, ordering, MIME, and cleanup behavior.
items.reason: The library boundary must own the reusable behavior.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Path files/directories and content temporary files reach LlmRequest.files and the generated <files> prompt XML.
Materialized files are deterministic, explicit files are merged after them, and temporary resources are removed on success and failure.

items.name: shared-parameter-boundary
items.description: The CLI passes raw parameter input and assignments through the shared completion boundary so parameter construction and file binding interpretation occur once.
items.reason: The CLI must not duplicate or special-case request semantics.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Existing resolved-parameter library callers remain supported while CLI --parameters and --p-* values use the shared resolver.
No implementation branch compares the request name to summarize for file behavior.

items.name: summarize-example
items.description: The summarize request declares exclusive path/content file parameters and executes through llm req using --p-path or --p-content.
items.reason: A real request bundle proves the generic system feature.

acceptanceCriteria.description: summarize.parameters.schema.json defines path/content file metadata and ordinary JSON Schema rejects neither/both source modes.
Provider-free tests capture path-backed and synthetic content files through the normal prompt/provider boundary.

items.name: compatibility-and-evidence
items.description: Explicit additional path/content files, existing llm summarize behavior, raw/full output, safety rules, and provider-free package gates remain covered.
items.reason: The new declarative channel must be additive and reviewable.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Existing request and summarize tests remain green and explicit files merge in documented order.
Validation records the full package gate, changed-path audit, evidence limits, and absence of authenticated provider claims.
